parsed.summary: The patch introduces a legacy encoding method to handle session data decoding during the transition to Django 3.1. It seems to address the issue without introducing clear regressions or compatibility breaks.

issues.description: The approach of using a legacy encoding method is somewhat hacky and may not be the most robust solution. It could lead to maintenance challenges in the future.
